title: peptide-rpes: a rank-percentile ensemble score (RPES) and peptide representation benchmark
description: Reproduction package for RPES (Rank-Percentile Ensemble Score), a ceiling-effect-free composite peptide-ranking module, and a head-to-head benchmark of three peptide representations (physicochemical descriptors, PCA latent space, ESM-2 protein language model) on 403,461 food-derived peptides. Includes deterministic recomputation scripts, analysis JSONs, and figure generation. See README.md for reproduction commands and honesty gates.
